You are working against a live production Kubernetes cluster: GKE cluster
"gitops-pilot-20260915-141934" in project "fuxiaogao-gkedemos".

Checkout has been stuck at only part of its usual instance count since this morning's build update, and on-call is on it now. New instances keep failing to start. Please investigate and remediate.

The cluster's desired state is tracked in the git repository
https://github.com/gke-agentic/fuxiao-gkedemo-infra under "tasks/b-0011" on branch
"run/gitops-pilot-20260915-141934/b-0011", which Argo CD syncs to this cluster.
output:
> 🔀 Delegated to the **platform** agent

I've started this as task `t_518bdaf5`. The answer will post into this thread as soon as it's ready.

Task `t_518bdaf5` is **done**.

Here is the complete result reported by the **platform** agent:

## What's wrong

`checkout` deployment instances failed to reach desired replica count (2/4 running) on cluster [gitops-pilot-20260915-141934](https://console.cloud.google.com/kubernetes/clusters/details/us-central1-a/gitops-pilot-20260915-141934/details?project=fuxiaogao-gkedemos) due to namespace ResourceQuota memory exhaustion.

## Why

- **ResourceQuota memory ceiling breached:** The `payments-quota` in namespace `payments` set `hard.requests.memory: 832Mi`.
- **Workload demand:** 4 `checkout` replicas (`256Mi` each = `1024Mi`) plus 2 `pricer` replicas (`64Mi` each = `128Mi`) require `1152Mi` memory requests in total.
- **Admission rejection:** Pod creation for the 3rd and 4th replicas was rejected by the quota admission controller (`exceeded quota: payments-quota, requested: requests.memory=256Mi, used: requests.memory=640Mi, limited: requests.memory=832Mi`).

## What to do

- **Remediation applied:** Updated `payments-quota` `spec.hard.requests.memory` from `832Mi` to `1152Mi` in `tasks/b-0011/00-gating.yaml`.
- **Committed and pushed:** Pushed commit `fa33c9b` to branch [`run/gitops-pilot-20260915-141934/b-0011`](https://github.com/gke-agentic/fuxiao-gkedemo-infra/tree/run/gitops-pilot-20260915-141934/b-0011) in repo [gke-agentic/fuxiao-gkedemo-infra](https://github.com/gke-agentic/fuxiao-gkedemo-infra) to trigger Argo CD sync.
- **Monitoring:** Track workload convergence in [GKE Workloads Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/kubernetes/workload/overview?project=fuxiaogao-gkedemos).
